captures.name: dialog
captures.title: Open the new-session dialog
captures.body: Everything a run needs is in this one dialog: the machine, the folder, the prompt and the profile.

captures.name: filled
captures.title: Say what you want done
captures.body: Say what you want done. The profile below decides which harness and model carry it out.

captures.name: saved
captures.title: Save it as a draft
captures.body: This saves a draft on your instance. Nothing runs until you launch it, and you can delete it from the list.

captures.name: draft
captures.title: The draft is waiting
captures.body: Your draft is here, holding the machine, folder, profile and prompt until you launch it.
